# An invoice whose `posted:` block gives the transaction from
# a_bank_purchase_with_its_guid.txt as its posting.
#
# That transaction moves money from the bank to supplies and has no split on
# `Assets:Accounts Receivable`, which the block posts to, so there is no split
# for the invoice's lot to hold.
#
# What this fixture produces: nothing. The import refuses the invoice.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_posting_the_book_holds_is_refused_where_it_cannot_be_the_records.py.
customer "C001"
	name: "Acme"
	currency: CAD

invoice "INV-POSTED-THROUGH-A-PURCHASE"
	customer_id: "C001"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-01-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-01
		description: "Service"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-02-01
		due: 2026-03-01
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "Paper"
		accumulate: true
		posted_txn_guid: "7a6b5c4d3e2f10a9b8c7d6e5f4a3b2c1"
